in_marathi.name: Dushala
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dushala हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dushala is a name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘duhsala’ which means ‘difficult’ or ‘afflicted’. In Hindu mythology, Dushala is the name of a princess who was cursed by the sage Durvasa due to her mother's disrespect towards him. Despite her difficult circumstances, Dushala is remembered for her unwavering devotion to Lord Rama and her compassion towards those in need.
